facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing Ecofin, says the new national PKI rests on the legal framework of Law No. 2013-546 on electronic transactions (article dated 2026-07-28; no day for the law given, 2013 from its number).
Biometric Update says decrees issued in 2014 and 2016 accompany the 2013 electronic transactions law, covering cryptology, electronic signatures and digital archiving.
facts.system: Decrees of 2014 and 2016 under Law No. 2013-546

systems.tiers: certification authorities and trust service providers in Côte d'Ivoire; no timeline for providers to begin using it
